address: 19 New Kirk Road, Bearsden, Glasgow City, G61 3SJ, United Kingdom
bio: A smart neighbourhood restaurant in a very smart neighbourhood, Elements occupies a swish, lavishly renovated premises blending royal blue fabrics with dark wood and gold furnishings. The kitchen applies classical techniques to top-quality Scottish ingredients, while incorporating some subtle international influences – West Coast langoustines combined with chawanmushi and vadouvan is a prime example. Each dish delivers an interesting range of flavours and textures, without ever being too showy in its makeup. The on-display wine is a nod to the well-stocked list featuring something for every palate and purse....
